root_cause_analysis: The editorial engine failed to locate a verified source draft for the current topic. The system logic explicitly forbids falling back to generic evergreen content when the primary source verification step fails, triggering a hard stop to prevent the dissemination of unverified market data.
actionable_instructions: Verify the integrity of the upstream data ingestion service to ensure source-verified drafts are being successfully persisted to the database.
Inspect the topic_data object passed to compose_carousel to determine if the source-verification flag was erroneously set to false or if the source URL is unreachable.
Manually trigger a re-fetch of the source material or update the editorial brief to point to a valid, verified data source.
